probes.original: Lebesgue测度下的有向分部积分。保留两函数的完整导数条件、导函数可积性与两个端点项；不要求a≤b。
probes.statement: ∀ (u v du dv : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt u (du x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt v (dv x) x) → IntervalIntegrable du volume a b → IntervalIntegrable dv volume a b → (∫ x in a..b, u x * dv x) = u b * v b - u a * v a - (∫ x in a..b, du x * v x)
probes.proof:
by
  intro u v du dv a b hu hv hdu hdv
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_mul_deriv_eq_deriv_mul hu hv hdu hdv

probes.original: u在两个端点均为零时的分部积分恒等式；保留全部导数和可积性条件，端点可反向。实际导入上一条已核验证明数据。
probes.statement: ∀ (u v du dv : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt u (du x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt v (dv x) x) → IntervalIntegrable du volume a b → IntervalIntegrable dv volume a b → u a = 0 → u b = 0 → (∫ x in a..b, u x * dv x) = -(∫ x in a..b, du x * v x)
probes.proof:
by
  intro u v du dv a b hu hv hdu hdv ha hb
  have h := MraCandidate.Reused.s0.checked u v du dv a b hu hv hdu hdv
  simpa only [ha, hb, zero_mul, sub_self, zero_sub] using h

probes.original: 一维光滑Poisson方程−u″=f对光滑零边界测试函数φ的积分恒等式。φ、u、u′的导数关系及所需区间可积性全部显式。这不是一般Sobolev弱解理论，也不证明存在性。
probes.statement: ∀ (u du ddu f φ dφ : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt u (du x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt du (ddu x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt φ (dφ x) x) → IntervalIntegrable du volume a b → IntervalIntegrable ddu volume a b → IntervalIntegrable dφ volume a b → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, -ddu x = f x) → φ a = 0 → φ b = 0 → (∫ x in a..b, du x * dφ x) = (∫ x in a..b, f x * φ x)
probes.proof:
by
  intro u du ddu f φ dφ a b hu hdu hφ hi hi2 hiφ he ha hb
  have h := MraCandidate.Reused.s0.checked φ du dφ ddu a b hφ hdu hiφ hi2 ha hb
  have heq : (∫ x in a..b, f x * φ x) = -(∫ x in a..b, φ x * ddu x) := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ x in a..b, -(φ x * ddu x)) := intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x hx => by rw [← he x hx, neg_mul, mul_comm (ddu x) (φ x)])
      _ = _ := intervalIntegral.integral_neg
  calc
    _ = (∫ x in a..b, dφ x * du x) := intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun x _ => mul_comm _ _)
    _ = - (∫ x in a..b, φ x * ddu x) := by rw [h, neg_neg]
    _ = _ := heq.symm
probes.source: checked zero-boundary-green proof data and intervalIntegral.integral_congr

by

probes.original: 额外要求a≤b，一维光滑零边界Poisson解的∫fu非负，依据已验证能量恒等式和逐点平方非负。完整导数、可积性、方程和边界条件保留。
probes.statement: ∀ (u du ddu f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt u (du x) x) → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt du (ddu x) x) → IntervalIntegrable du volume a b → IntervalIntegrable ddu volume a b → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, -ddu x = f x) → u a = 0 → u b = 0 → a ≤ b → 0 ≤ (∫ x in a..b, f x * u x)
probes.proof:
by
  intro u du ddu f a b hu hdu hi hi2 he ha hb hab
  rw [← MraCandidate.Reused.s0.checked u du ddu f a b hu hdu hi hi2 he ha hb]
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall hab (fun x => mul_self_nonneg (du x))
